tool_input.command:
cat tsconfig.json; cd src/art && sed -i \
 -e "s/^export { telegraphMast };$//" \
 -e "s/^  telegraphMast,$//" \
 -e "s/    extra: cat(486, 104 - 33, '-2px'),\n//" \
 scenes.ts && grep -n "extra: cat\|fx: (x, top) => cat\|name: 'ink barrels', x: \(168\|470\|580\|122\)" scenes.ts
tool_input.description: Show tsconfig and clean unused exports in scenes
Move hero and bookshop props, re-snap stats
